notes.title: Fantasy Shootoff – Patch v34.6.6
notes.notes:
[h1]What’s New?[/h1]

[h2]New Mana Stone Skill (Mage Class)[/h2]
A must-have for mana-hungry mages looking to outlast their foes in the heat of battle!
[list]
[*] Unlocks at Level 4
[*] +200 Max Mana
[*] +45% Mana Regeneration Rate
[/list]

[h2]New Hexagon Shield[/h2]
Add this stylish defense tool to your loadout and watch enemies struggle to break through.
[list]
[*] Plasma-infused Rare Shield – built for resistance and resilience
[*] Unlocks at Level 5
[*] +18–23 Armor
[*] +8–11 Lightning Resistance
[*] +12–16 Magic Resistance
[/list]

[h1]What’s Changed?[/h1]

[h2]UI Control Shortcuts:[/h2]
Take control of your screen with new toggle options:
[list]
[*] [b]ALT + H[/b] → Hide UI elements (Action bar, health bars, etc.)
[*] [b]ALT + C[/b] → Hide Chat window
[*] [b]SHIFT + \[/b] → Hide Crosshair
[*] [b]SHIFT + - (Hyphen)[/b] → Enter Spectate Mode (Observe the chaos without being part of it!)
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[h2]Play Go Away[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where the Select Mode widget wouldn't disappear.
[*] Now, pressing Play will correctly remove the widget as intended. No more stuck menus!
[/list]

That’s all for now, heroes! Dive in and try out the new mana mechanics or slap on that shiny shield. More updates soon—until then, keep slinging spells and dodging blades!

notes.title: Fantasy Shootoff – Springtacular 2025 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Springtacular 2025![/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051163/124a151cc86c1c8eb68fac5b83b1823a2fc26e7e.png[/img]
Spring is blooming—and so is the action! Celebrate the season with festive challenges, a fresh new biome, and tasty surprises in this year’s Springtacular event!


[h2][b]New Spring-Themed POI: Bloomgrove[/b][/h2]
A once-hidden meadow has burst into life!

[list]
[*] Bloomgroveis a brand-new, limited-time Point of Interest located near the city.
[*] Features vibrant wildflowers, beautiful butterflies, and colorful eggs.
[/list]


[h2][b]New Healing Item: Chocolate Bunny[/b][/h2]
Delicious AND life-saving.

[list]
[*] The Chocolate Bunny is a limited-time consumable healing item.
[*] Restores 300% of health—but don’t eat too many too fast, or you’ll get the Sugar Rush debuff (slightly reduced movement speed for 3 seconds).
[*]Can be found in loot chests in Bloomgroveis.
[/list]


[h2][b]Gameplay Updates & Fixes[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] New Item: Chocolate Bunny healing item added.
[*] New POI: Bloomgrove biome now available for all players during Springtacular.
[*]New Springtacular Quest
[*] Fixed: Enemy aggro in forest zones behaving unpredictably.
[*] Fixed: Party UI not updating when players leave during active fights.
[/list]


[h2][b]Final Notes[/b][/h2]
Get in while the sun’s shining! Springtacular 2025 runs from April 6th, until May 3—explore, collect, and survive the season with some chocolate-fueled fun. 🌷


[b]Event Duration: April 4 – May 3, 2025[/b]
[b]Version: 34.5.2[/b]

notes.title: New v33.2 Update | Fantasy Shootoff
notes.notes:
[h1]New Audio Update![/h1]

After reading some player feedback from last week, we got to work to make the game feel more alive. So one of the things we thought we could fix is the audio cues for weapons and abilities.

[h2]What's Changed?[/h2]

[list]
[*]New [b]Blink skill[/b] audio cue
[*]New [b]AOE Heal[/b] audio cue
[*]New [b]Spin Attack[/b] audio cue
[*]New [b]Small Orb Attack[/b] audio cue
[*]New [b]Orb Attack[/b] audio cue
[*]New [b]Beam Attack[/b] audio cue
[*]New [b]Arrow Attack[/b] audio cue
[*]New [b]Mount[/b] sound effect
[/list] 

[h2]What's New?[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]New Tang flag:[/b] After killing all the Tang Warriors, go to the Tang flag and get within attacking range, once you do, a tip will pop up on the screen explaining how to destroy the flag. To be able to destroy the flag you need to have a Red Gem fragment in your inventory. Remember, once you destroy the flag that session will end and everyone will be kicked. So make sure your ready. 

[*][b]Feedback button:[/b] In the "About" section in the main menu, there is a new "Feedback" button that opens a browser tab to a Google form page, fill out the page to give feedback on the game.
[/list]

notes.title: Fantasy Shootoff Patch v29.21
notes.notes:
[b]7/25/2024[/b]

[b]By Operation Games[/b]

[b]New Features/Additions:[/b]
- 3 New skills

[b]Patch Notes Details:[/b]
First new skill is called "Brand Of Evil", this active skill is similar to the "Rage" skill. When activated players enter into a rage mode making it harder to get stunned and giving players a 15% physical damage buff. The "Brand Of Evil" skill is only usable for Worriers, Assassins, Hunters and Tanks. The second new skill is called "Poison Pop", this passive skill gives players a poisonous effect dealing 12% damage for 3 sec to any enemy you hit. This skill is only usable for Worriers, Assassins, Mages and Tanks. The third new skill is called "Vade Of Healing", this active skill restores 35% of any missing health for 7 sec. This skill is only usable for Hunters and Mages.

[b]Quality of Life Updates:[/b]
 - In-game UI health & mana bars are lighter in color making it easer to see

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
-The in-game flying bug has been fixed

notes.title: Fantasy Shootoff Patch 29.20
notes.notes:
[b]7/16/2024

By Operation Games
[/b]
[b]New Features/Additions:[/b]
- New main menu UI
- Controller input

[b]Patch Notes Details:[/b]
In this update Fantasy Shootoff’s Sunny Summer event is now over, this means that the summer POI’s are no longer on the island, the limited time items like the Ice cream cone have been removed and there is only 1 trampoline left on the island. V29.20 also brings us a new update to the Main menu UI. The menu buttons are no longer on the left side of the screen but they are now on the top of your screen with a brand new look. Another new feature is the new Controller input, this gives players who don’t like or aren't good at mouse and keyboard to be able to play Fantasy Shootoff. You can use your controller by clicking Shift + Tab and the Steam in-game menu will pop up and that's where you can activate the Steam Controller, when you do this you can change your controller settings and sensitivity. Please note that if you don’t activate the Steam Controller, playing with a controller will not have all the controls and it will not work properly.

[b]Quality of Life Updates:[/b]
 - New skill icons

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
-Small in-game lighting bugs have been fixed

notes.title: Fantasy Shootoff Patch v29.0 Season 4 Chapter 5: VIBIN
notes.notes:
6/10/2024

By Operation Games

Overview:
With the G.I.U defeated, the island residents throw one big party, building a stage and a new city for guests and residents to enjoy. But the A.T is a little concerned about the meteor that crashed into the island.

New Features/Additions:
- New stage POI
- New city POI
- Meteor crash site
- 2 new weapons
- 1 weapon old weapon added
- New enemies NPCs 


Patch Notes Details:
Welcome to VIBIN, a brand new chapter bringing a new Stage POI called “BeatBurst Stage'', a City POI called “Mountain View”, Meteor crash site, 2 new weapons and an old weapon has returned. Season 4 chapter 5 brings us 2 new weapons, first the Baseball Bat and second the Boom Bat. The Baseball Bat does 121 Attack power, 41 Strength and -6% movement speed. The Boom Bat does 147 Attack power, 11 Strength and when holding it music plays. The Havoc Sword has also returned. With this new chapter also comes new enemies called Skellingtons, if you're lucky you might run into Jack. This chapter will be live from June 10th - Aug 20th.  


Practice Game Mode:
 - Sword X, Baseball Bat and Boom Bat weapons added
 - New Skellington NPCs added


Quality of Life Updates:
 - In-game gold Hud frame removed for a cleaner look
 - New loading screen

Balance Changes:
- NPC’s have a higher stun resistance


Bug Fixes:
-The in-game lighting bug has been fixed
